method: Read-only MODBUS40 read requests via POST /api/v1/discovery/probe in 18 sequential 32-ID sessions (15:29-15:44 CET, batch 12 onward re-run after the 15:37 gateway restart), values from GET /api/v1/registers/explorer after each session; 30 poll-list registers taken from the poll loop; 32 dynamic registers re-read 3x at ~3 min intervals (15:45, 15:48, 15:51). No writes.
